description: Mechanical cross-check of central_bridge_triangle_pole_forcing.md: the degree-forcing argument (a cubic aligned pole X_x has only one spare edge once P_2 is required to avoid Y_x, forcing Y_x onto P_1 adjacent to X_x); the resulting forced power-of-two cycle of length exactly 2^rho_x (confirmed for rho_x in {2,3,4,5}), eliminating T3 entirely and restricting T2 to the last row of central_bridge_triangle.md's V.1 table (both poles equal to the shared non-cubic vertex); confirmation that the surviving row's shared pole is genuinely non-cubic (degree 6 in the constructed gadget) so no forced-cycle contradiction applies there.

degree_forcing.conclusion: case (ii) [chord, Y_x on Theta_x via P_1] is forced
